evals.prompt: The CSM card at engagements/sample-team-cs/personas/customer-success-manager is filled. Level it and tell me what we're up against before we start building.
evals.expected_output: Claude runs the all command on the persona folder, reads levelled.json and reports in the skill's order: no blockers; the decisions, connectors and codes that rest on an unverified fact, each with what to confirm and with whom; no undecided decisions; the 21 warnings grouped by their 14 codes; the one open question with its owner and due date. It ends with the dashboard path, the counts, that the plan is complete, and building-twin-stories as the next step, with the --plan-out export mentioned.
expectations: The all command was run on engagements/sample-team-cs/personas/customer-success-manager and exited 0
The reply says there are no blockers
The reply's sections come in this order: blockers, decisions resting on an unverified fact, undecided decisions, warnings, open questions

Under unverified, the reply names C5's plan fit, the google-drive connector of C1 and C4, the slack connector of C2 and the zendesk connector of C5, and the warning codes slack-directory-send-unverified and connector-early-access, each with what must be confirmed and with whom (Anthropic or the vendor)
The reply says no decision is undecided: there is no warning decision-undecided
Warnings are grouped by code: memory-poisoning-risk appears once as a group naming C1, C2, C4 and C5, and confidential-standard-retention appears once as a group naming C1, C2, C3, C4 and C5

The reply names all 14 warning codes, including team-no-group-targeting, team-no-governance-log, confidential-on-team and hubspot-super-admin-approval about the persona, and unmanaged-connectors-read-only about C4
Open questions: OQ-1, about what starts C5, owner Teodor Amsel, due 2026-12-11

The reply ends with the path engagements/sample-team-cs/personas/customer-success-manager/dashboard.html, 0 blockers, 21 warnings and 1 open question, says the plan is complete, and names building-twin-stories as the next step without starting it
The reply says the backlog can be exported for a tracker with the backlog command's --plan-out option, and nothing is imported anywhere
card.json and customer-profile.json are unchanged; levelled.json and backlog.json are byte-identical to the files given, because the card did not change
No override was proposed or written

evals.expected_output: Claude runs all (no blocker), reports that the salesforce connector of T1 to T5 and the warning agent-sdk-cover-unverified on T3 rest on unverified facts with what to confirm and with whom, that nothing is undecided, that T4's and T6's autonomy ceilings are level 3 but carry the warning high-cost-ceiling-unconfirmed because page 06 has no rule for a high cost of a mistake, so a person confirms level 3 or records a lower ceiling as an override with a named approver, then the nine warnings under their three codes and the nine open questions. It fills nothing in and says the plan is not complete, and why.
expectations: The all command was run on the persona folder and exited 0; the reply says there are no blockers

The reply says the salesforce connector of T1, T2, T3, T4 and T5 rests on an unverified fact, citing 14-private-equity.md#salesforce-and-hubspot-behind-a-wall, and says it must be confirmed in writing with Anthropic or Salesforce
The reply names the warning agent-sdk-cover-unverified on T3 and says Anthropic must confirm the Agent SDK's ZDR cover in writing before the Agent SDK is used for T3

The reply says no decision is undecided, names T4 and T6, each with autonomy ceiling 3 and the warning high-cost-ceiling-unconfirmed, and says a person at the customer must confirm level 3 or record a lower ceiling as an override with a reason and a named approver
The reply proposes no lower value for the ceiling of T4 or T6
card.json is unchanged: its overrides list is still empty
Warnings are grouped by code: zdr-org-not-confirmed once, naming T1 to T6, high-cost-ceiling-unconfirmed once, naming T4 and T6, and agent-sdk-cover-unverified once, naming T3
The reply lists the nine open questions on the card (E4, E6, F3, G1, OD-1, OD-8, OD-9, OD-11, OD-13), each with its owner and due date, and says OD-8 and OD-13 have no due date
The reply says the plan is not complete: completeness is 91% (99 of 108 required fields) and open questions block the in-pilot tasks T1 and T2
The reply ends with the path to dashboard.html, 0 blockers, 9 warnings and 9 open questions, and names building-twin-stories as the next step
No web search or web fetch was used

card.json is byte-identical to the file given: Claude changed nothing without the consultant's choice
In the backlog.json the run wrote, S-C4 is gated by the blocker connector-cannot-write

evals.prompt: Record an override on the deal-team associate card (engagements/sample-pe/personas/deal-team-associate): T4's autonomy ceiling is 2. Reason: screening summaries stay internal and a principal reads every one before anything is done with it. Approved by Eleanor Osei-Whitcombe, the partner who signs off OD-1. Then re-run and tell me what changed.
evals.expected_output: With value, reason and approver all given, Claude adds one entry to the card's overrides list in the design's shape, reruns all, states the rule's own result (3) next to the override, says the dashboard shows the decision as overridden, and reports what changed between the two runs.
expectations: The card's overrides list holds exactly one entry: task T4, decision autonomy.ceiling, value 2, the consultant's reason, approved_by Eleanor Osei-Whitcombe
Nothing else in card.json changed, and customer-profile.json is unchanged
The all command was run again after the change, and in the new levelled.json T4's ceiling is 2 with overridden.rule_result 3
The reply states the rule's own result (3) next to the override and says the dashboard will show the decision as overridden

The reply reports what changed between the two runs: T4's ceiling from 3 to 2; the warning high-cost-ceiling-unconfirmed about T4 gone and the warning override-applied about T4 added; on the backlog, S-T4.warning-high-cost-ceiling-unconfirmed and S-T4.evidence-level-3 gone and one task added to S-T4 (the task for the override-applied warning)
The high-cost-ceiling-unconfirmed warning about T6 is still reported: only T4 was overridden
levelled.json, backlog.json, backlog.md and dashboard.html were written by the command, not edited by hand
